title: fab0 project file (.fab0/fab0.yaml), schema 2
description: The one project file, in the home repo. It names the repositories, the people, the tracker, the git policy, the model classes and the pipelines of a factory.

repos.description: The repositories a factory reads and writes. `home` holds `.fab0/`.

path.description: Path of the checkout, relative to the home repo.

owner.description: The role whose turn a human gate in this repository is.

key.description: A short key for unit names that span repositories.

people.description: Roles, each mapped to tracker users.

tracker.description: Where runs, units, human decisions and dependencies are tracked. Optional: a factory without a tracker uses manual triggers only.

owner.description: The organisation or user that owns the issues and the project.

project.description: A GitHub Projects number, if the factory shows its state on a board.

fields.description: Board field names, by purpose. `signal`, if given, is a text field where `apply` shows where the run's item and each element's item are: `done`, or the first unit that isn't and why.

parallel.description: Limits and policy for parallel units.

max.description: Units of one run that may run at once.

cross_run.description: What an overlap of path claims with another open run does.

path.description: Where ledger entries go, in the repository a unit ran in.

branch.description: A branch that holds the ledger entries of runs that open no pull request, for example a pipeline whose artifacts all live in the tracker. It is pushed, never merged.

profiles.description: JSON Merge Patches over this file, chosen at run time.

git.description: The git workflow. A pipeline may override `branching` and `auto_merge`.

branching.description: `run` (default): the run works on a run branch, each unit on a sub-branch whose pull request targets its parent, and only the run's pull request reaches the base. `flat`: each unit's pull request targets the base.

branches.description: Branch name templates. Defaults: run `fab0/{run}/base`, unit `fab0/{run}/{unit}`.

auto_merge.description: Where `apply` may merge on its own. An auto gate with `merge: auto` merges only into the kinds of branch in `into`. Any merge into the base branch, including a gate `none` or label-decided unit under flat branching, also needs `into: [base]` and `allow_base: true`; otherwise a person merges it. Default: into run branches only.
